note: Short summaries of what repeats in Google reviews, written in our own words (not quotes). Only a few Google reviews per place were read, so treat each one as a rough picture.

spots.towncentre: A favourite for an easy lap around the lake, with a playground, a spray park and plenty of lawn to spread out. Parking is free and there's lots of it. The winter lights are a big draw, but washrooms can run short on busy event days.
